title: Lively Lebanese Chickpea Ouzi
description: A flavorful and healthy Middle Eastern-inspired dish featuring chickpeas, lebanese bread, and crispy vegetables.

ingredients.name: crisp carrots
ingredients.notes: use a food processor to get the right crunch

ingredients.name: chickpeas
ingredients.notes: canned chickpeas work well for this recipe

ingredients.name: ouz
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds a nice smoky flavor

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: for brushing the bread and sautéing the vegetables

instructions: Cut the lebanese bread into 1-inch cubes and spread on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with 1 tbsp of olive oil and toss to coat. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
In a large skillet, heat the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped lively greens and sauté until wilted, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the grated carrots and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Stir in the chickpeas, ouz (if using), lemon juice, and garlic powder.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
To assemble the dish, place a layer of toasted bread on a serving platter or individual plates.
Top with a layer of the chickpea and vegetable mixture, followed by another layer of bread.
Repeat this process one more time, finishing with a layer of bread on top.
